title: Whole Life Insurance Loyalty Provision: Reduced Loan Interest Rate at Anniversary Capitalization for Long Continuous Coverage
content:
**Applies to:** loan interest capitalized on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy at a policy anniversary, including a policy issued by conversion of an Ashgrove Term Life Insurance policy.

## Provision

The series rate of an anniversary capitalization is reduced for long continuous coverage on the insured. Coverage is counted in whole months to the anniversary from the issue date of the Ashgrove Term Life Insurance policy converted into this policy, or from this policy's own issue date when it was not issued by conversion. The reduction is:

- **1.5 percentage points (0.015)** where the count is at least **360** months (30 years) and the policy has never been reinstated;
- **0.75 percentage point (0.0075)** where the count is at least **240** months (20 years) but below 360 months and the policy has never been reinstated;
- nothing otherwise.

The rate charged is the series rate less the reduction.

## Records read

- The whole life policy record: its issue date, whether it was converted from an Ashgrove term policy (the converted term policy reference), and its reinstatement date, which is empty when the policy has never been reinstated.
- For a converted policy, the issue date on the Term Life Insurance policy record of the converted term policy.

A whole month is counted each time the same day of the month as the start date is reached; a part month is not counted.

## Decision table

| Whole months to the anniversary | Ever reinstated | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 360 or more | No | 0.015 |
| 240 to 359 | No | 0.0075 |
| Below 240 | No | None |
| Any count | Yes | None |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Term Life Insurance policy issued March 15, 1994, converted into this whole life policy in 2009, never reinstated. At an anniversary of March 1, 2024 the count is 359 months: reduction 0.0075. At March 15, 2024 the count would be 360 months: reduction 0.015.
- The same history but reinstated in 2016: no reduction at either date.
- A whole life policy issued on its own application on September 1, 2004, never reinstated: at the anniversary of September 1, 2024 the count is 240 months, reduction 0.0075; a series rate of 7% becomes 6.25%.
